scientific_integrity: Proved density, branch transition, inversion and sharp endpoints-only ambiguity are separated from finite computational corroboration; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Solid right circular cones in three dimensions only; directions are Haar uniform and widths exact. The inverse law does not give finite-sample stability. A potentially relevant earlier cone planar-projection paper was not available in full; no claim of exhaustive historical novelty is made.
title: Unlabeled directional widths determine a right circular cone
